title: ds-bridge analytics (analytics --format json / --emit)
description: Output of `ds-bridge analytics` (SPEC-analytics-export §3): the merged document (schema ds-bridge/analytics) or one per-domain artifact (schema ds-bridge/analytics/<domain>). Additive changes keep schemaVersion 1; a removal or type change bumps it. Objects are open (no additionalProperties: false) so newer additive output still validates; ds-bridge's tests check every emitted key is declared.
